Definition: (causative) to bone, i.e. denude (by extensive, craunch) the bones
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cut off, reserve, lay aside, leave, save; 1a) (Qal) to reserve; 2) (Piel) to break bones, gnaw bones, break
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
